market_view: Calm VIX (15.7) but the 10-year yield hit a new high at 5.16% with a firmer dollar; WSJ says 'Yields Subside, Stocks Breathe Easier' this morning. Oil is torn between U.S.-Iran peace talks and Houthi attacks on Saudi facilities.

oil_gas.reasoning: Houthi attacks on Saudi facilities (Al Jazeera) lifted Brent 3.4%, but 'Oil prices slide about 2% as US, Iran explore path out of war' (Yahoo) and record Saudi exports (CNBC) undercut a lasting outage. Attack move already priced; talks not collapsed. Stay flat.

gold_miners.reasoning: 10-year at a 52-week high of 5.16%, dollar firm, gold below $4,300 and 19% off high; inflation expectations spiked. No Fed pause or safe-haven spike. Flat.

chips.catalyst: Continuing NVDA hold on Huang's guidance to make twice as many chips next year ('Huang's 2x Chip Vow Could Buy 37% of 2027 HBM Supply', shattered.io); demand pull not yet fully reflected with NVDA 4.7% below high while AMD made a new high.
chips.reasoning: Long since 2026-09-17; finish the planned window to about 2026-10-01. Yield at 5.16% is near my exit trigger and Oracle's force majeure notice worries AI bulls, so confidence trimmed, but WSJ reports yields subsiding and no guidance cut or export rule.

pharma.reasoning: 'FDA approves Lilly's Olumiant ... for pediatric patients' (Eli Lilly) is a small label expansion, not a GLP-1 approval or readout; LLY already +2.7% on the day. Flat.

copper_uranium.reasoning: 'BHP halts giant Chile copper mine after worker death' (AFR) is a named outage but likely a short safety halt; copper rose only 0.6% and one-off incidents fade in days. Peru projects add future supply; uranium weak. Flat, watch halt length.

would_change_my_mind: A multi-week BHP Chile halt (FCX), collapse of U.S.-Iran talks or lasting Saudi damage (XOM), a Fed pause (NEM), or a 10-year jump well above 5.2% or an AI capex scare spreading from Oracle (exit NVDA).

handoff.what_changed: The 10-year reached a new high at 5.16% (5-day +4.4%) though WSJ says yields subsided this morning; gold fell below $4,300. Houthis claimed attacks on Saudi facilities (Brent 106.6, +3.4%) while U.S.-Iran talks advanced and Saudi exports hit a war-time high. BHP halted a giant Chile copper mine after a worker death; Oracle's force majeure notice unsettled AI bulls.

chips.why: Huang's 2x chip guidance intact; no guidance cut or export rule; exit about 2026-10-01 or earlier on a yield spike or AI capex scare.

pharma.why: Olumiant pediatric alopecia approval is minor; no GLP-1 catalyst.

copper_uranium.why: BHP Chile halt after a worker death looks short; copper barely moved.
